logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

B verification illustration for WO-02: a single bar chart of measured energy per candidate on the shared HVAC duty-test basis, bars in table order P1, P2, P3, P4 with heights proportional to 50, 33, 20 and 9 kWh. Gridlines every 10 kWh; each bar annotated with quality index and raw defect count; P4 highlighted as lowest-energy qualifying winner with a dashed 9 kWh minimum line and a gap-ladder footer (P3 +11, P2 +24, P1 +41 kWh; consecutive spacing 11/13/17). Footer notes that cost, delivery and maintenance data are unsupplied and unweighed. Purpose: let the QA handover re-verify eligibility, ranking and gaps at a glance. No decorative or hidden elements.
